approvals.name: generate_image

style.prompt:
Create one square typography-only book swap event poster. Flat solid pale butter-yellow background. All lettering pure black, no other ink colors. Straightforward exceptionally readable clean sans-serif typography, centered alignment, generous margins and whitespace. Exactly three text lines, spelled precisely with the exact capitalization and punctuation below:
BOOK SWAP
Saturday 10-2
Maple Hall
Make BOOK SWAP the largest bold headline in the upper-middle area, Saturday 10-2 medium size below it, and Maple Hall slightly smaller below that. Only those three text strings may appear. No additional wording, no pictures, no illustrations, no icons, no books, no decoration, no border, no textures, no gradients, no shadows. Flat front-facing finished poster artwork filling the square, not a mockup.
